outcome_analysis: MosaicVoice is alive and listed by aggregators as a small private company with about 11 employees. No funding announcement or exit was found. Aggregators disagree on raised capital. The story is a slow bootstrapped path without verifiable traction metrics.
notes: Unverified aggregator funding: CB Insights $500K over 4 rounds, PitchBook seed $2.52M Dec 2021 and $3.02M total, Welcome to the Jungle $0.2M June 2022; one profile lists $500K from Unpopular Ventures, Ulu Ventures and YC. Competitor search returned only 2026 vendor pages (Balto, Observe.AI, CallMiner, Level AI), so the list is empty. Completeness pass: the 2021-12 seed (2.52M USD) and 2022-03-29 accelerator round rest on PitchBook only; the 2025-08 accelerator round rests on CB Insights (also Caplight). PitchBook lists L-SPARK, Y Combinator and Adapt Ventures across its rounds. CB Insights total of 500K and Welcome to the Jungle 0.2M June 2022 conflict and are not recorded. Total raised is uncertain.
